metadata_only_basis.plant_inventory_rule: only complete atoll vascular-plant inventories are included by the source dataset

focal_response.endpoint: species presence versus catalogue-confirmed absence within complete native vascular-plant inventories

ecological_hypothesis.name: source_pool_handoff_independent_atoll_test
ecological_hypothesis.statement: As access to continents or large volcanic islands becomes extreme, native plant occurrence should depend increasingly on continuity with occupied atoll source networks rather than generic mainland/high-island access alone.

response_independent_isolation.primary_extreme_rule: upper 25% of the frozen eligible-atoll major-landmass-distance distribution

response_independent_graph_rule.radii_rule: derive four radii before response access from the q25, q50, q75 and q90 distribution of each atoll's nearest-neighbour distance among eligible atolls; round upward to whole kilometres and require four strictly increasing positive radii
response_independent_graph_rule.generic_gateway_state: for each radius, focal atoll component contains at least one atoll whose distance to a continent or large volcanic island is <= that radius
response_independent_graph_rule.generic_connectivity: fraction of frozen radii with generic_gateway_state=true
response_independent_graph_rule.source_conditioned_connectivity: fraction of the same frozen radii whose focal component contains an outer-training occupied atoll for the focal species
response_independent_graph_rule.multihop_state: source-conditioned connectivity at smallest frozen radius AND nearest outer-training occupied source distance exceeds that radius

source_pressure_rule.definition: sum exp(-distance / s) over outer-training occupied atolls
source_pressure_rule.s: median nearest-neighbour distance among eligible atolls computed from safe geometry before response access

spatial_validation_template.pilot_confirmatory_split_rule: after safe metadata opening, normalize archipelago names and rank SHA256('atoll-plants-v1|' + archipelago_name); lowest 20% enter burned pilot and remaining 80% confirmatory, with explicit lists frozen before response access

preintake_stop_conditions: exact downloadable data-package identity cannot be resolved
content-blind archive inventory cannot separate vascular-plant response from safe atoll metadata/geometry
response or unknown file values are exposed before intake freeze
plant inventories are not identifiable as complete atoll inventories
required atoll/archipelago identifiers cannot be joined without inspecting response values
geometry-only radii rule cannot produce four distinct radii
archipelago count cannot support the frozen pilot/confirmatory split minima
next_action: resolve exact FAIR2 data-package files and checksums content-blind; assign file roles; do not parse vascular-plant records
